unit_cn: Unit 5 Launching Your Career 开启职业生涯
source: 人教版2019选择性必修四 Unit 5 词表(p51-60 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、求职/简历/面试/职业规划主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: The test uses a code that indicates your overall work personality.
words.example_cn: 这个测试用一个代码来表明你整体的职业性格。

words.meaning_cn: 委员会;市政机构;理事会
words.example_en: The summer camp council is looking for enthusiastic high school helpers.
words.example_cn: 夏令营委员会正在招募热情的高中帮手。

words.example_en: Please send your CV and a cover letter to the receptionist.
words.example_cn: 请把你的简历和求职信发给接待员。

words.example_en: He dedicated his whole career to research on rare seeds.
words.example_cn: 他把整个职业生涯奉献给了对珍稀种子的研究。

words.example_en: She has always wanted to become a detective and solve real cases.
words.example_cn: 她一直想成为一名侦探,去侦破真实的案件。

words.example_en: A good CV shows potential employers your skills and experience.
words.example_cn: 一份好的简历能向潜在雇主展示你的技能和经验。

words.example_en: He hopes to be an entrepreneur and start his own small company.
words.example_cn: 他希望成为一名企业家,创办自己的小公司。

words.example_en: As an estate agent, she helps people buy and sell houses.
words.example_cn: 作为一名房地产经纪人,她帮助人们买卖房屋。

words.meaning_cn: 资金;财政;金融;提供资金
words.example_en: She helped manage the finances and receipts during the city tour.
words.example_cn: 她在城市游览期间帮助管理财务和收据。

words.example_en: It would be greedy to focus only on money and fame in a career.
words.example_cn: 在职业中只盯着金钱和名声未免太贪心了。

words.example_en: The job advertisement asks for a friendly attitude and good handwriting.
words.example_cn: 这则招聘广告要求有友好的态度和工整的书写。

words.example_en: My English is at an intermediate level, so I can talk with visitors.
words.example_cn: 我的英语是中级水平,所以我能和访客交谈。

words.example_en: I want a career in law because fairness and justice matter to society.
words.example_cn: 我想从事法律工作,因为公平和正义对社会很重要。

words.example_en: He plans to become a lawyer and protect people's legal rights.
words.example_cn: 他打算成为一名律师,保护人们的合法权益。

words.meaning_cn: 使适应;使面对;确定方向
words.example_en: Social jobs are people-oriented and often involve helping others.
words.example_cn: 社会型工作以人为本,通常包括帮助他人。

words.example_en: The career test gives each participant a work personality code.
words.example_cn: 这个职业测试给每位参与者一个职业性格代码。

words.meaning_cn: 优先事项;首要的事;优先
words.example_en: As team captain, I learned how to decide on priorities under pressure.
words.example_cn: 作为队长,我学会了在压力下决定优先事项。

words.example_en: With my proficiency in calligraphy, I could teach short classes.
words.example_cn: 凭着我对书法的精通,我可以教授一些短期课程。

words.meaning_cn: 简介;概述;侧面;扼要介绍
words.example_en: Read the two profiles below and write a paragraph about one person.
words.example_cn: 阅读下面两份人物简介,就其中一人写一段话。

words.example_en: I kept every receipt while managing the money for the tour.
words.example_cn: 在管理这次游览的费用时,我保留了每一张收据。

words.example_en: Send your application to the receptionist at the front desk.
words.example_cn: 把你的申请发给前台的接待员。

words.example_en: Think about a likely scenario for your future career and plan ahead.
words.example_cn: 设想一种你未来职业的可能情景,提前做好规划。

words.example_en: You will be required to supervise and help out in many tasks.
words.example_cn: 你将被要求监督并协助完成许多任务。

words.meaning_cn: 共产主义的;共产主义者
words.example_en: Marx is known as the founder of international communism.
words.example_cn: 马克思被称为国际共产主义的奠基人。

words.meaning_cn: 社会主义的;社会主义者
words.example_en: He devoted his life's work to socialist ideas and social justice.
words.example_cn: 他把毕生的事业奉献给了社会主义思想和社会公正。

words.example_en: Some students go into debt to pay for training that helps their career.
words.example_cn: 有些学生为支付有助于事业的培训而负债。

words.meaning_cn: 绘画的;图案的;图表;图形
words.example_en: A graphic designer needs to be creative and imaginative.
words.example_cn: 平面设计师需要有创造力和想象力。

words.example_en: He enjoys numbers, so he wants to teach maths and geometry.
words.example_cn: 他喜欢数字,所以想教数学和几何。

words.example_en: One task was to keep the parking area clean for new guests.
words.example_cn: 其中一项任务是为新来的客人保持停车区整洁。

words.example_en: Applications can also be made on paper or disk if you prefer.
words.example_cn: 如果你愿意,申请也可以用纸质或磁盘形式提交。

words.example_en: At the camp, visitors can learn to knit with wool.
words.example_cn: 在营地里,游客可以学习用毛线编织。

words.example_en: Knitting with wool is one of the fun activities at the camp.
words.example_cn: 用毛线编织是营地里好玩的活动之一。

words.example_en: Campers can learn to sew a small purse by hand.
words.example_cn: 营员们可以学着手工缝制一个小钱包。

words.example_en: Purse sewing is a popular craft activity at our summer camp.
words.example_cn: 缝制钱包是我们夏令营里很受欢迎的手工活动。

words.meaning_cn: 油炸;油煎;油炒;油煎食物
words.example_en: At the camp, visitors can fry fish over an open fire.
words.example_cn: 在营地里,游客可以在篝火上煎鱼。

words.example_en: The athlete broke her wrist and needed months of rest.
words.example_cn: 这名运动员摔断了手腕,需要数月休养。

words.example_en: At the pet shop, I checked and changed the flea collars.
words.example_cn: 在宠物店里,我检查并更换灭蚤颈圈。

words.example_en: The medicine chest had countless small drawers full of herbs.
words.example_cn: 那个药柜有无数装满草药的小抽屉。

words.example_en: A spy must be observant and good at keeping secrets.
words.example_cn: 间谍必须观察敏锐,且善于保守秘密。

words.example_en: The Frog and Fox Summer Camp is near a quiet canal.
words.example_cn: 蛙与狐夏令营坐落在一条安静的运河旁。

words.example_en: Dr Zhang dreamed of turning the desert into green farmland.
words.example_cn: 张博士梦想把沙漠变成绿色的农田。

words.example_en: Watching water split into oxygen and hydrogen drew her to chemistry.
words.example_cn: 看着水分解成氧气和氢气,使她爱上了化学。

words.example_en: Marie Curie discovered radium and devoted her life to science.
words.example_cn: 玛丽·居里发现了镭,并将一生献给科学。

words.example_en: First let us define what a great career really means.
words.example_cn: 首先让我们界定一下伟大的职业究竟意味着什么。

words.example_en: To build a great career, you need to commit yourself to something meaningful.
words.example_cn: 要成就伟大的事业,你需要把自己投入到有意义的事情上。

words.example_en: A secretary should be organised and good with details.
words.example_cn: 秘书应当条理清晰,且善于处理细节。
